title: esbuild
description: An extremely fast JavaScript bundler written in Go.

data.text: esbuild is a JavaScript bundler and minifier written in Go. It is 10-100x faster than JavaScript-based bundlers because it leverages Go's parallelism and native performance. It supports TypeScript, JSX, and tree-shaking out of the box.

data.content: Bundle an entry point with esbuild.

data.title: Speed Advantage
data.text: esbuild can bundle an entire app in milliseconds, making it ideal for development and CI/CD.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: esbuild is written in Go for maximum speed
Often used as an underlying bundler for tools like Vite
data.takeaway: esbuild redefines bundler performance with Go-based architecture.
